build_TinyViT_backbone: build a TinyViT vision transformer backbone model with configurable architecture settings like 5m, 11m, or 21m
create_ConvBN2d_module: create a Conv2d plus BatchNorm2d module with optional kernel fusion for inference optimization
build_PatchEmbed_layer: build a patch embedding layer using stacked convolutions to project input images into feature space
create_TinyViTBlock_with_window_attentio: create a TinyViT transformer block with local window attention and depthwise convolution
build_BasicStage_with_checkpointing: build a multi-block stage of TinyViT blocks with optional gradient checkpointing for memory efficiency
